title: Expand ai-vm disk
prompt_template: Grow VM 110's disk from 100 GB to 2 TB on ZFS pool 'oasis'. Stops at disk resize — does NOT configure filesystem or install anything.

title: Expand ai-vm RAM
prompt_template: Increase VM 110's RAM from 16 GB to a level sufficient for model serving + engine services (e.g., 32–48 GB) using host's ~88 GB available. Stops at RAM allocation change.

title: Resize ai-vm filesystem
prompt_template: Inside VM 110: grow the partition/filesystem to use the newly allocated 2 TB disk. Assumes T3 ran. No other changes.

title: Deploy engine services
prompt_template: Inside VM 110: docker compose up -d for the engine stack. Stops at all containers running. Does NOT configure inference routing or test.
